description: Get the people Fundz already holds for one company: name, role, department and email where we have it. Takes the company id or slug returned by search_funding_rounds and the other feeds. Each email carries its verification status and date where Fundz holds one, and the result shows which of your own LinkedIn connections work there. Reading these costs nothing. If a contact has no email yet, reveal_contacts can fetch one.

company.description: Company id or slug, e.g. "overfuel" or "181403" (search results include this)

with_email_only.description: Return only contacts that already have an email address

name: get_company_contacts
title: Get company contacts
